description: This file contains multiple implementation of the knapsack problem algorithms, including greedy, integer linear programming (ILP), dynamic programming (DP), and a space-efficient divide-and-conquer DP with Hirschberg's trick for activation checkpointing in PyTorch.

methods.name: tuple[float,list[int],list[int]] greedy_knapsack( memory: list[float], runtimes: list[float], max_memory: float )
methods.description: Implements a greedy heuristic for the knapsack problem based on runtime-to-memory ratio, selecting items until max_memory is reached.

methods.name: tuple[float,list[int],list[int]] ilp_knapsack( memory: list[float], runtimes: list[float], max_memory: float )
methods.description: Solves the knapsack problem using scipy's mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) solver with a linear constraint for memory.

methods.name: tuple[float,list[int],list[int]] dp_knapsack( memory: list[float], runtime: list[float], max_memory: float )
methods.description: Uses a pseudopolynomial dynamic programming approach with quantized weights to find the maximum runtime within memory constraints.

methods.name: tuple[float,list[int],list[int]] dp_knapsack_sliding_hirschberg( memory: list[float], runtime: list[float], max_memory: float )
methods.description: A memory-efficient divide-and-conquer DP implementation using Hirschberg's algorithm for large-scale activation checkpointing with an explicit stack to reduce memory footprint.
